false_negative_audits.original_supporting_evidence: St. Francis Xavier remained absent from the funnel despite a current thesis-based Computer Science MSc, required supervisor route, and an official statement that most accepted students receive tuition plus partial living support.

KTH was represented only by a doctoral route despite a current Fall 2027 English Computer Science MSc with software technology, automated testing, reliable and secure software, a research project, published selection statistics, and a competitive tuition scholarship.
